explanation: An orthogonal set requires every pair of distinct vectors to have dot product zero. U fails because its first two vectors have dot product -10-3+0=-13. V fails because its dot product is -18-2=-20. In W, the three pairwise dot products are 2-1-1=0, 0-1+1=0, and 0+1-1=0. Therefore W only is orthogonal.
